resolved_gaps.title: MCP HTTP transport at /mcp/
resolved_gaps.build_instructions: Add HTTP transport to the MCP server. The spec requires both HTTP at /mcp/ and stdio. Currently only stdio is implemented. Use FastMCP's streamable_http transport or mount the MCP server at /mcp/ in the FastAPI app. File: src/ferrite/mcp_server.py (and optionally src/ferrite/api.py for mounting).

resolved_gaps.title: get_provenance MCP tool
resolved_gaps.build_instructions: Add get_provenance MCP tool. Returns the provenance chain: agent → channel → session → episode → source for a given fact ID. Cross-namespace chains truncate with redacted_beyond_this_point. Files: src/ferrite/mcp_server.py (register tool), src/ferrite/query.py (add get_provenance function). Query: traverse SOURCED_FROM edges from Fact → Episode → Session, collect agent/channel metadata.

resolved_gaps.title: list_episodes MCP tool
resolved_gaps.build_instructions: Add list_episodes MCP tool. Returns recent episodes ingested. Parameters: limit (default 20), since (datetime, optional). File: src/ferrite/mcp_server.py (register tool), src/ferrite/query.py (add list_episodes function). Query: MATCH (e:Episode) WHERE e.recorded_at >= $since RETURN e ORDER BY e.recorded_at DESC LIMIT $limit

resolved_gaps.title: CI grep test banning raw MATCH strings
resolved_gaps.build_instructions: Add a CI step in .github/workflows/ci.yml that greps src/ferrite/*.py for raw 'MATCH' strings (banned per §6.3 — all Cypher must go through a query builder that injects namespace filters). The grep should fail the build if raw MATCH is found in handler code (excluding test files and the query.py builder itself). Example: grep -rn 'MATCH' src/ferrite/*.py | grep -v query.py | grep -v test_ && exit 1 || true
